description: Update a recurring calendar event. Changes to title/description/notes/reminders patch existing instances. Changes to frequency/dates/time regenerate future instances.

cronExpression.description: New interval as 'N Unit', Unit one of Day, Week, Month, Year, e.g. '2 Week'. Not cron syntax.

description.description: New description, patched onto existing instances.

duration.description: Length of each instance, ISO 8601 duration e.g. 'PT30M'.

endDate.description: New last date, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty string leaves it unbounded.

id.description: Template id from list_recurring_calendar_events or create_recurring_calendar_event.

isAllDay.description: True for all-day instances, false for timed. An all-day instance starts at midnight of its occurrence date in the template timezone (stored in UTC; omit startTime) and ends duration later (no end without a duration), so a duration of one day or more makes each instance span that many whole days.

location.description: Replaces the location outright. $type 'Address' takes line1-3/postalCode/countryCode; 'OnlineLocation' takes url/notes.

line1.description: Address line 1. An Address needs one of line1-3 or postalCode.

line2.description: Address line 2, e.g. flat or suite.

notes.description: Access detail, e.g. parking or passcode.

reminderOffsetMinutes.description: New reminder lead times, in minutes before each occurrence starts. Send the full list: it replaces the current one. [] clears all reminders; omit to keep them. A change also applies to existing instances. Each value is whole hours, 60-1380 (1-23 hours), or whole days, a multiple of 1440 up to 40320 (4 weeks, the most for a repeating item); a week is 10080. Up to 5 values. An all-day event counts from 00:00 on its first day, so 300 (5 hours) is 19:00 the evening before. Day and week reminders arrive at 19:00 on the earlier day; hour reminders arrive that many hours before the start, or up to 15 minutes earlier. Every household member is reminded.

items.description: One lead time in minutes: whole hours 60-1380, or a multiple of 1440 for days.

startDate.description: New first-instance date, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty string clears it.

timezone.description: IANA zone for startTime, e.g. 'Europe/London'. Occurrences follow its DST.

title.description: New title, patched onto existing instances.

name: update_recurring_calendar_event
